digest.component_or_area: CLI dispatcher and gate enforcement on relocated tracker stores
propositions: When REBAR_TRACKER_DIR relocates the store outside the repo, nine sites derive config root as os.path.dirname(tracker), which has no rebar.toml and resolves an empty config.

The plan-review start-work gate on 'transition open→in_progress' silently stops applying on a relocated store because transition.py:275 passes dirname(tracker) as repo_root to gates.plan_review_precheck, and an empty config reads gate flags as OFF.
The CLI dispatcher passes dirname(tracker) as repo_root to every command, causing the entire CLI to inherit the co-located-store assumption.
Eight of nine identified sites must resolve config from the actual repo root instead of dirname(tracker); one site (run_sweep detached child) requires a deferred design change.
A static guard must fail if new bare os.path.dirname(tracker)-as-config-root sites are introduced.
